name: Mato Grosso
summary: A blue field with a white rhombus holding a green globe and a yellow star whose points touch the globe's edge.
origin: News of the Republic reached Cuiabá only on 9 December 1889. The first governor, Antônio Maria Coelho, created the flag by decree on 31 January 1890, making it one of the first Brazilian state flags.

colors.name: Blue
colors.meaning: The sky over Rio de Janeiro on the night of the Republic.

colors.name: Green
colors.meaning: Hope and nature; the state's size.

symbols.name: Yellow star
symbols.description: A star touching the edges of the globe.
symbols.meaning: Sirius, which represents Mato Grosso on the national flag.

facts: It is one of the oldest Brazilian state flags.
The star is Sirius, the brightest star in the night sky.
clues: A green globe with a yellow star inside a white rhombus, on blue.
Its star is the brightest in the night sky.
One of the first state flags of the Republic.
